prompt: A realistic classroom scene, cinematic photography style, eye-level perspective. In the center, a single student sits at a desk covered with stacks of identical exam papers. Every paper has the exact same questions, and the student is confidently writing perfect answers, surrounded by neatly solved sheets. The student appears focused and overly confident. Behind the student, a chalkboard shows repeated patterns of the same solved problem written over and over again, filling the board densely. To the side of the classroom, a different desk holds a new exam paper with slightly different questions. This paper is untouched. The same student is now looking at it with visible confusion and hesitation, unable to answer. The rest of the classroom is empty, emphasizing isolation and narrow focus. Lighting: warm spotlight focused on the memorized papers and the confident version of the student; the area with the new unseen questions is dimmer and colder. Mood: uneasy, ironic, highlighting misplaced confidence and failure outside familiarity. Color palette: warm tones around repetition and memorization; cold desaturated tones around the unfamiliar problem. No text, no labels, no numbers, no symbols, no charts, no diagrams.
metaphor: student memorizes identical questions perfectly but fails when slightly different questions appear
